SELECT "USER_ID"
FROM "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."USERS"
WHERE "USER_ID" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY MD5_NUMBER_LOWER64('7:' || TO_VARCHAR("USER_ID")), "USER_ID"
LIMIT 10000

WITH TMP as (
  SELECT
    f.index as __KUMO_BATCH__,
    f.value[0]::NUMBER as __KUMO_ID__,
    f.value[1]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_END_TIME__,
    f.value[2]::TIMESTAMP_NTZ as __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM TABLE(FLATTEN(INPUT => PARSE_JSON(?))) f
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "ORDERED_AT"
FROM TMP
JOIN "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."ORDERS"
  ON "USER_ID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ORDERED_AT" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
AND "ORDERED_AT" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "ORDERED_AT" <= ?
AND "ORDERED_AT" > ?
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ORDERED_AT", "ORDER_ID"

SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__ as __KUMO_BATCH__, "ORDERED_AT", "QUANTITY", "ORDER_ID", "PRODUCT_ID", "USER_ID"
FROM TMP
JOIN "<redacted:parity_snowflake_database>"."PARITY_SHOP"."ORDERS"
  ON "USER_ID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ORDERED_AT" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ORDERED_AT" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
WHERE "ORDERED_AT" <= ?
  AND "ORDERED_AT" > ?
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
  ORDER BY "ORDERED_AT" DESC, "ORDER_ID", "PRODUCT_ID", "QUANTITY", "USER_ID"
) <= 32
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ORDERED_AT" DESC, "ORDER_ID", "PRODUCT_ID", "QUANTITY", "USER_ID"
